entries.change: genesis: the queue/profile schemas and semantic checks as the F-13 pilot met them — the baseline JobFinderOS's 5 Nov queue was written under (registered retroactively by F-66)

migration.note: the starting rules; nothing predates them

entries.change: budget caps: budget.max_turns <= 200 and wall_clock_min <= 150 (owner-confirmed) — work that needs more must be sliced

migration.note: a draft-only stale queue is re-proposed under the current caps; a task past draft needs its budget edited per task and the contract re-approved (`factory approve <task>`)

entries.change: declared file scope: scope.paths is a precondition of approval for build/docs tasks; malformed scope patterns (absolute, .., catch-all, character classes) refuse the load; profile paths.generated obeys the same rules

migration.note: the re-proposal drafts scope.paths for every task; review the globs, then approve per task (`factory approve <task>`)

entries.change: model-provider rules: a client project refuses without an explicit non-zai provider block; region/base_url presence and shapes per kind; an egress allowlist entry naming a model-provider host that is not the project's own inference host refuses (JobFinderOS's profile refused on docs.z.ai)

migration.note: edit project.yaml first (remove or replace the refused host, kind or region), then re-approve the profile

entries.change: project.schema.json gains the verification block (one verifier per finding) — additive: nothing that loaded before refuses

migration.note: an addition that tightens nothing; no project needs to act

entries.change: epochs themselves: tasks.schema.json's version loosened from const 1 to integer >= 1 (the semantic layer bounds the ceiling at the current epoch); the approval ledger gains the optional repo_path field on profile entries; factory doctor reports every check through all-errors loaders

migration.name: restamp-version
migration.note: TaskQueue.save and the import write path re-stamp the queue's top-level version to the current epoch; it runs only on queues that already validate under the current rules (the loaders refuse anything else) and never touches a task field, so no approved contract's hash covers it

entries.change: model registry: a client project with no recorded model_restrictions answer (none | no_china | contained, with who answered and when) refuses the load; the profile gains model_stack and model_restrictions (F-63 security groups) and seat_providers admits final_review.fix/.strong; provider.models becomes the deprecated optional override (the registry stack fills every seat the block does not pin)

migration.note: record the client's onboarding answer in the profile's model_restrictions block (the default answer is none — clients are open by default, F-59's blanket client/zai refusal is replaced by that answer) and re-approve the profile
